infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Faves uses your location to show spots near you and to check you are at a spot before you post a moment.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Faves uses the camera to post a moment from the spot you are at.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Faves records sound with your moment clips.
